ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels localized at the distal tips and along specific scratch trajectories.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous mottling is restricted to the outer 15% of the distal lobes; central and proximal fluke regions consist of a uniform low-intensity dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees; bounding-box depth is roughly 1/10th of the total visible fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serration across the entire trailing edge; peaks are irregular with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels relative to the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave trajectory observed where the trailing edge curves inward from the distal tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (white) detected at the terminal ends of both lobes, particularly dense on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) observed on the left lobe, oriented diagonally from the leading edge toward the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged segments and small focal notches along the trailing edge topography that deviate from standard serration patterns.
